name: SmartTags
description: Represents the collection of smart tags for a control on a form, report, or data access page.
remarks: To return a single SmartTag object, use the Item property or use SmartTags (_Index_), where _Index_ represents the number of the smart tag.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Use the Application property to access the active Microsoft Access Application object and its related properties. Read-only Application object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: The Item property returns a specific member of a collection either by position or by index. Read-only SmartTag.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Use the Count property to determine the number of items in a specified collection. Read-only Long.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a smart tag to a form or control.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the smart tag to add.
